rules.if: candidate asserts document revision, repeal, replacement, effective state, version identity/relation, current-history binding or a date expressly performing one of those functions
rules.then: version_claim_status is PRESENT_*; correctness depends on frozen evidence

rules.if: candidate asserts only adoption, promulgation, publication, publication date or document number, without version semantics
rules.then: version_claim_status == NOT_PRESENT; evaluate any institutional issuer/publisher/adopting claim independently under authority

rules.if: an institution is only a substantive operational or evidentiary actor, with no issuer/publisher/adopting/revising/competence claim
candidate expressly attributes issue, publication, adoption, revision, source authority or statutory competence to an institution
rules.then: authority_claim_status is PRESENT_*; correctness depends on frozen evidence

rules.if: reviewer identity/session independence/package routing is defective
rules.then: record in review_run_metadata / blind_review_process_QA; never create a candidate-level phase2_issue solely for this defect

supersedes_v4_phrase_only: V4's OTHER real schema/process defect cannot be used for reviewer-run identity/session/routing defects; row-level candidate/evidence/schema-interface defects remain candidate issues
